{{Quote|Glad to share my skills with someone talented.|Yem Ordalien|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Yem Ordalien''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Ordalien wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] pieces, and had a number of golden [[Ring/Legends|rings]] on the numerous head tendrils common to their [[Species/Legends|species]]. Ordalien wielded a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and they were stationed at the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] when the Empire [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] the world<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Yem Ordalien first appears as the Jedi Knight class trainer on Corellia in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> The walkway to reach the class trainers on Corellia is indicated in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', though as they are situated on an upper level, the trainers are not identified with individual icons.<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
